title: Give each journey spec well-formed test URNs naming its own subject

facts.note: Branch A, part 1: filename suffix only. The suffix alone does NOT establish a browser spec; it must also be run by Playwright (next fact).
Branch A, part 2: an observer must establish that the `*.e2e.ts` file is in the Playwright runner's test set (e.g. matched by the Playwright config's test dir/match). Not inferred from the suffix.
Branch B, part 1: any test file, regardless of name.

Branch B, part 2: header comment scan for `// Train:`, `// Journey:`, `// URN: test:train:…`, `// URN: test:journey:…`, so misnamed specs are still judged; a URN merely in a string literal does not count.

Applies to both branches: vendored and generated trees are never scanned. Activation = (Branch A: *.e2e.ts AND run by Playwright) OR (Branch B: test file AND header journey marker), outside these trees.

fires: A `*.e2e.ts` file that Playwright runs is added or edited and has no test URN.
A journey spec carries a URN with an unknown harness code, a non-three-digit number, or no slug.
A test file not named `*.e2e.ts` has a `// Journey:` header and a URN naming a different journey than its binding.
A journey spec's test title URN names a train other than the one its valid binding header declares.
doesNotFire: A unit test that merely mentions a journey URN inside a string literal.
A `*.e2e.ts` file not run by Playwright and with no journey marker in its header comments.
A journey spec whose binding header is itself malformed — the URN-vs-binding comparison is skipped (format is still checked); the binding is reported by `tester.htmx.journey-binding-header`.

given: A browser spec: a `*.e2e.ts` file run by Playwright, or any test file whose header comments carry a journey marker (`// Train:`, `// Journey:`, `// URN: test:train:…`, `// URN: test:journey:…`).
when: The spec is written or changed.
then: It carries at least one test URN `test:{train|journey}:<id>:{E2E|SMOKE|A11Y|VIS|RESP}-NNN-<slug>`, and every URN it carries is well-formed and names the subject its binding header declares.
prefer: Same URN in header and test title, e.g. `test:train:orders:place-order:E2E-001-places-an-order`.
The harness code matching what the test exercises.
avoid: Malformed URNs (wrong prefix, unknown harness code, missing NNN or slug).
URNs naming a different train/journey than this spec's binding.
Renaming a spec away from `*.e2e.ts` to dodge the check; header markers still apply.
unless: Malformed binding header: no URN-vs-binding comparison; `tester.htmx.journey-binding-header` alone reports it.
why: The URN identifies the test instance and its harness. A malformed URN, or one naming another subject, silently traces the result to the wrong place.
evidence: htmx_e2e_detector reports no journey-urn-format finding for the spec.
Every browser spec has ≥1 URN matching the grammar, and each URN's train/journey id equals the subject of its valid binding header.
verifier_detail: Browser spec = `*.e2e.ts` run by Playwright, OR any test file whose header comments carry `// Train:`, `// Journey:`, `// URN: test:train:…`, `// URN: test:journey:…` (so misnamed specs are still judged). A unit test that merely mentions a journey URN in a string is not one.
Grammar: `test:{train|journey}:<id>:{E2E|SMOKE|A11Y|VIS|RESP}-NNN-<slug>`; at least one per spec; every URN must match.
Compare URN subject with binding only when the binding is valid; malformed binding reported solely by `tester.htmx.journey-binding-header` (no duplicate finding).
audit: schema_version 1.1.0; kind rule; status active; introduced_in 0.5.0.

additions.text: The harness code matching what the test exercises.
additions.justification: Makes the harness-code part of the grammar actionable; graph edges show A11Y/VIS/RESP specs are identified by their harness code.
